scoping_law.spec_mandate: N15: model-check (Erlang TLC or Elixir property equivalent) box-diamond-admitted under weak fairness
scoping_law.delivered: bounded model checking as the honest TLC substitute — exhaustive state-space model check of the net itself. The in-repo capital is already formal (1-safe Petri net over u16 masks: ronr::RONR + invariants::reachable_bitset), so the court fully enumerates the reachable marking graph (40 markings from 0x0081 under all 12 verbs — complete enumeration, zero sampling) and evaluates CTL □◇disposition as graph reachability from every reachable marking, plus explicit witness/adversary schedules. TLC's automaton-product liveness is replaced by the reachability reduction: terminal (disposition) markings are absorbing and every non-trap marking has a path to one, so every weakly-fair infinite run reaches a disposition; the fairness definition is spelled out precisely in the test module header. Erlang TLC (PlusCal spec + TLC launcher) = documented follow-up, not delivered.

court.fairness_definition: Weak fairness (TLC default): every transition continuously enabled from some point on must eventually fire. From any marking with N_DEBATABLE set, verb 0x05 (previous question) is enabled; the only verbs that do not clear N_DEBATABLE are 0x03/0x04 (amend/unamend — re-produce it) and 0x0C (division, pre=0x0000). Any infinite schedule looping on those keeps 0x05 continuously enabled, so a weakly fair schedule must fire 0x05, after which 0x06 (adopt) is continuously enabled (only 0x06 itself consumes SECONDED|PREV_QUESTION_MOVED), so fairness forces adoption. Hence every weakly-fair run from a non-trap marking reaches a disposition and the □◇ verdict reduces exactly to the reachability check executed.

part1_model_check.net: ronr::RONR, 12 verbs, boolean 1-safe u16 place masks, m0 = 0x0081 (MAIN_MOTION|FLOOR)

full_net.trap_structure: RECESS_PENDING and/or POINT_OF_ORDER_RAISED with DEBATABLE cleared and no resolving arc in the table — a modeled-vocabulary gap (the net has no recess-end / ruling arc), reachable only through the non-admission interrupt verbs 0x09/0x0B
full_net.verdict: □◇disposition holds on 36/40 markings; the 4 counterexamples are typed and pinned — any ronr::RONR change that adds/removes a trap or resizes the reachable set fails the court

admission_subnet.excluded_verbs: 0x09 (recess), 0x0B (point of order) — interrupt verbs with no resolving arc
admission_subnet.verdict: □◇disposition holds on the ENTIRE admission subnet reachable set; adoption is reachable (non-vacuous) and absorbing (no transition consumes N_ADOPTED). Combined with the fairness reduction this is the delivered liveness theorem: every weakly-fair run reaches a disposition.

part3_starvation_counterexample.purpose: exhibit a deliberately unfair schedule that DOES starve, typed — proving the monitor can see starvation
part3_starvation_counterexample.exhibit_A_RingFullPinnedClaims: claim all 4 slots, never commit: every subsequent claim() refuses (ConsensusError::RingFull domain, claim()==None); monitor reads it exactly: claimed_count()==capacity, abandoned_count()==0; typed recovery via abandon() unblocks claim()
part3_starvation_counterexample.exhibit_B_DrainHogging: 8 committed words, unfair scheduler runs consumer A first: A drains 8, B drains 0 (< fair share 4) — per-consumer tallies (the monitor) exhibit the starvation exactly; claimed_count()==0 proves it was scheduling, not word loss
part3_starvation_counterexample.type_guard: n15_starvation_types_are_consensus_types pins the vocabulary to the real consensus surface (ConsensusError::RingFull)

findings.note: Model-check finding: the full 12-verb RONR net is NOT trap-free — 4 of 40 reachable markings (recess/point-of-order traps, witness path 01-02-09) admit no disposition. Honest-scoping handling: traps typed, pinned, and excluded from the liveness theorem via the admission subnet (which is fully live, 0 violations). During development, two scratch-calculation errors (mis-transcribed t2/t3 post masks producing phantom states 0x2884/0x6884 and a 1020-state estimate) were caught by the court itself — the exhaustive pin (40, exact trap set) refused both, which is the pin doing its job.
